item.text: I found that the existing KEV loader only fetches CISA catalog records and the current `go-kev` config has no separate VulnCheck source. I’ll preserve that data flow, map CISA records into the new first-class field, and make the model and JSON parser accept source-tagged VulnCheck records (including nested XDB and reported exploitation details) when they are present.

The model now has `KEVs`, source-specific details, and a KEV count in the text summary. The detector converts CISA data into the new field while retaining the legacy CISA alert, and its decoder handles source-tagged VulnCheck entries when supplied. I’m formatting the edits and compiling the affected packages now.
